impact.note: Rule-based, in a SQL transaction pipeline

bullets.t: Cut unmatched Zelle transactions from 34.6% to 11.7% and lifted Cash App merchant resolution to about 90% by writing Redshift SQL (regex extraction, CTEs, waterfall count queries) for Venmo, Zelle, PayPal, and Cash App descriptions, and regex mapping rules for T-Mobile, AES, Southern California Edison, and Xcel Energy. Validated with Excel coverage formulas and lookalike checks to prevent false positives.

Evaluated an AI merchant-naming prompt against Finicity names using Excel models (COUNTIFS, match-status formulas) and root-cause analysis. A/B tested revisions, measured run-to-run variance, and caught a rule change that lowered accuracy before adoption.

Validated matching and reporting logic using test cases and mock transaction datasets in SQL and Excel (SUMIFS, period-over-period comparisons), reconciling outputs to expected results and escalating defects, including a regex error, to protect data accuracy.

Conducted quantitative and time-series analysis in R on multi-year transportation and commodity datasets, uncovering lead-lag relationships between rail flow patterns and corn and wheat basis spreads, which informed pricing-strategy adjustments.

Designed predictive analytics and forecasting frameworks using regression-based financial modeling, lead-lag analysis, SHAP analysis, and walk-forward validation, producing more reliable commodity-basis forecasts that supported pricing-strategy decisions.

Developed analytical reports and business intelligence insights translating transportation, logistics, and commodity market data into recommendations on supply-demand conditions, market trends, and operational performance.

Cut procurement costs by 12% by modeling vendor quotes against acquisition, logistics, and resale pricing assumptions in SQL and Excel, giving the team a cost comparison to anchor supplier negotiations.

Raised gross profit by 8% by testing markup thresholds and resale margins against purchase price and transportation costs to set profitable pricing ranges, and recommending the procurement and pricing decisions that followed.
Built Power BI dashboards tracking purchase trends, vendor performance, and cost variance, giving finance leadership one view of procurement performance and cost drivers.
Performed budgeting and cost analysis for industrial compressor procurement, comparing budget vs. actuals to flag cost variances early and support forecasting and sourcing decisions.

projects.name: FinScope
projects.subtitle: Personal FP&A and market analytics platform

bullets.t: Built and deployed a full-stack FP&A web platform automating budget vs. actuals variance analysis with auto-generated driver commentary, three-statement reporting, and one-click formatted Excel variance reports, backed by a SQL transaction pipeline with 98% rule-based categorization accuracy.

Implemented champion/challenger forecasting in Python, backtesting four time-series models on holdout data to reduce MAPE to 6.7% versus a 9.9% baseline, and engineered a 10,000-path Monte Carlo planning engine driven by live S&P 500 returns and FRED inflation data.

Integrated the SEC EDGAR API to analyze real 10-Q and 10-K filings for any US public company, resolving XBRL tag inconsistencies and deriving Q4 from fiscal-year totals. Shipped with 17 pytest tests and GitHub Actions CI.

projects.name: Credit Card Debt Risk and Consumer Behavior
projects.subtitle: Undergraduate dissertation, Shiv Nadar University

bullets.t: Performed statistical modeling and machine learning analysis in Python (pandas, scikit-learn) and SQL, applying feature engineering and model evaluation to identify elevated-risk debt accumulation patterns and consumer overspending drivers.

Applied segmentation analysis to identify the 30–40 age group as the most debt-prone segment, and distilled the psychological factors influencing credit card usage and repayment behavior to inform targeted financial interventions.
